title: PWA / Mobile Web MVP Polish
completionDefinition: Phase 8B should polish the mobile-first React Web / PWA MVP brief, UX acceptance criteria, package consumption expectations, and trial-readiness checklist.

8B must not implement the production user app, backend, database, accounts, analytics, camera, AR, training, OpenAI API, external APIs, native iOS, React Native, Flutter, ecommerce, community, paid features, app store release work, online publication, or new runtime dependencies unless explicitly authorized by a future phase gate.
8B must not bootstrap a separate production app repository unless the owner explicitly expands scope.
Makeup Engine must remain the template production system and UserAppTemplatePackage must remain the handoff contract.
Docs and project-state must remain recoverable and validation commands must pass.
Tests passed and validation commands pass before 8B completion is accepted.
dependsOn: 8A Product Route Decision / App MVP Planning
